recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. The source already reflects the final WG decision, and adding a category code now would conflict with the Jira resolution that intentionally moved the MAR-entry distinction from category/stage to intent.
issue_request: FHIR-12388 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU2 Pharmacy issue. Although the initial request mentioned adding a MAR-entry code to medication-request-category, the Jira comments redirected the concept to MedicationRequest.intent and the carried motion was to add instance-order to the medication-request-intent value set and make intent a search parameter.
initial_application: Jira records revision @10662. The corresponding git-svn commit 7975773ab18e3799e0e0d5223493e46cb2ea3b3a explicitly says TR#12388 added instance-order to the value set for MedicationRequest.intent and TR#12447 added MedicationRequest.intent as a search parameter; its patch added both changes to the old MedicationRequest spreadsheet source.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription is now MedicationRequest and source/fhir.ini lists medicationrequest as active. Later source refactors preserved the applied value and search parameter in the current XML source. FHIR-12447, the companion search-parameter request, is already represented on the combined branch. Later decisions FHIR-34218 and FHIR-13999 refined the same intent value set by clarifying MAR wording and correcting hierarchy without removing the seed's instance-order concept.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The active MedicationRequest CodeSystem contains instance-order with MAR-oriented wording, the MedicationRequest intent ValueSet includes the complete CodeSystem, MedicationRequest.intent is bound to that value set, and the MedicationRequest-intent token SearchParameter uses expression MedicationRequest.intent.
